BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_VNET_NOT_EXIST.desc: BGP neighbor vrf_name references a non-existing VNet.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_LF_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description contains LF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_CR_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description contains CR.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_CRLF_NAME.desc: Template-based BGP neighbor description contains CRLF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_INVALID_ENFORCE_FIRST_A.desc: Invalid boolean value for enforce first AS.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_NAME.desc: Incorrect neighbor name in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAXTHRESHOLD.desc: Invalid maximum prefix warning threshold in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_SOFT_RECFG_I.desc: Invalid boolean value for soft reconfiguration-in in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_SEND_COMNTY.desc: Invalid value for send community type in neighbor AF.

BGP_PEER_GROUP_AF_NEG_PEER_GROUP_NOT_EXI.desc: Referring non-existing BGP peer group table.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_INVALID_SOFT_RECFG_IN.desc: Invalid boolean value for soft reconfiguration-in in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_INVALID_SEND_COMNTY.desc: Invalid value for send community type in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_ROUTE_MAP_VALID.desc: Validate route-map reference in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_ROUTE_MAP_NOT_EXIST.desc: Missing or non-existent route-map reference in peergroup AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_IN.desc: Invalid route-map in count in neighbor AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_OUT.desc: Invalid route-map out count in neighbor AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_IN.desc: Invalid route-map in count in peergroup AF.

BGP_PEERGROUP_AF_NEG_INVALID_MAP_OUT.desc: Invalid route-map out count in peergroup AF.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_INVALID_HOPS.desc: Invalid TTL hops for unnumbered interface neigbhor.

BGP_MONITORS_NEG_MULTILINE_NAME.desc: BGP monitor description contains a newline.

BGP_PEERRANGE_VALID_VNET.desc: Configure BGP peer range with a valid vnet.

BGP_PEERRANGE_VALID_VRF.desc: Configure BGP peer range with a valid vrf.

BGP_PEERRANGE_INVALID_VNET_OR_VRF.desc: Configure BGP peer range with an invalid vnet or vrf.

BGP_SENTINEL_INVALID_NAME_MISMATCH.desc: Sentinel name must still equal its key.

BGP_SENTINEL_NEG_LF_EQUAL_NAMES.desc: Equal sentinel key and name containing LF fail the pattern, not equality.

BGP_SENTINEL_NEG_CR_EQUAL_NAMES.desc: Equal sentinel key and name containing CR fail the pattern, not equality.

BGP_SENTINEL_NEG_CRLF_EQUAL_NAMES.desc: Equal sentinel key and name containing CRLF fail the pattern, not equality.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_V6ONLY_PORTCHANNEL_VALID.desc: Configure BGP interface neighbor with v6only on PortChannel interface.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_V6ONLY_VLAN_VALID.desc: Configure BGP interface neighbor with v6only on Vlan interface.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_V6ONLY_IP_INVALID.desc: v6only cannot be configured for IP-based BGP neighbors.
BGP_NEIGHBOR_V6ONLY_IP_INVALID.eStr: v6only can only be configured for interface-based BGP neighbors

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_INTF_ETHERNET_VALI.desc: Configure BGP interface neighbor on Ethernet interface using BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_INTF_PORTCHANNEL_V.desc: Configure BGP interface neighbor on PortChannel interface using BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_INTF_VLAN_VALID.desc: Configure BGP interface neighbor on Vlan interface using BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_V6ONLY_ETHERNET_VA.desc: Configure BGP interface neighbor with v6only on Ethernet interface using BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_V6ONLY_IP_INVALID.desc: v6only cannot be configured for IP-based BGP neighbors in BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_LIST.
BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_V6ONLY_IP_INVALID.eStr: v6only can only be configured for interface-based BGP neighbors

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NO_HW_OFFLOAD_BFD_UNRESTRIC.desc: Without hardware BFD offload (NPU switch) bfd can be enabled without profile/full timer set and with any FRR-legal interval; the offload-only musts do not apply.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_RT_VALID.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn with a route-distinguisher, import/export route targets and advertise-ipv4-unicast.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_LEAVES_VALID.desc: The EVPN leaves frrcfgd renders: advertise-default-gw (address-family and per-VNI), default-originate, flooding and duplicate-address detection.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_FREEZE_SECONDS_V.desc: dad-freeze takes a number of seconds as well as 'permanent'.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_DISABLED_WITH_MA.desc: dad-max-moves and dad-time are rejected while dad-enabled is false: the command re-enables detection.
eStr: dad-max-moves cannot be set while dad-enabled is false

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_DISABLED_WITH_FR.desc: dad-freeze is rejected while dad-enabled is false.
eStr: dad-freeze cannot be set while dad-enabled is false

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_MAX_MOVES_OUT_OF.desc: dad-max-moves below FRR's minimum of 2 is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_TIME_OUT_OF_RANG.desc: dad-time above FRR's maximum of 1800 is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_FREEZE_OUT_OF_RA.desc: A dad-freeze below FRR's minimum of 30 seconds is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_FLOODING_UNKNOWN_VAL.desc: flooding accepts head-end-replication and disable only.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DEFAULT_ORIGINATE_ON.desc: The EVPN leaves are rejected outside l2vpn_evpn.
eStr: default-originate-ipv4 is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
advertise-default-gw is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
default-originate-ipv6 is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
flooding is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
dad-enabled is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
dad-max-moves is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
dad-time is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family
dad-freeze is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_BOUNDS_VALID.desc: dad-max-moves at FRR's maximum of 1000 and dad-time at its minimum of 2.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_MAX_MOVES_ABOVE_.desc: dad-max-moves above FRR's maximum of 1000 is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_FREEZE_MAX_VALID.desc: dad-freeze at FRR's maximum of 3600 seconds.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_DAD_FREEZE_ABOVE_MAX.desc: A dad-freeze above FRR's maximum of 3600 seconds is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_IPV4_FORM_VALID.desc: BGP Address Family l2vpn_evpn route-distinguisher in the <IPv4>:<number> form.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_ON_IPV4_UNICAST_I.desc: route-distinguisher is rejected on the ipv4_unicast address family.
eStr: route-distinguisher is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_IMPORT_RTS_ON_IPV4_U.desc: import-rts is rejected on the ipv4_unicast address family.
eStr: import-rts is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_ADVERTISE_IPV4_UNICA.desc: advertise-ipv4-unicast is rejected on the ipv4_unicast address family; it only means anything inside l2vpn_evpn.
eStr: advertise-ipv4-unicast is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_MALFORMED_INVALID.desc: A route-distinguisher that is not in <AS|IPv4>:<number> form is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_VALID.desc: Per-VNI EVPN configuration with a route-distinguisher and import/export route targets.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_ADVERTISE_SVI_IP_VA.desc: Per-VNI advertise-svi-ip. FRR scopes this to one VNI, distinct from the address-family-wide advertise-svi-ip on BGP_GLOBALS_AF.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_BARE_VALID.desc: A per-VNI row with no optional fields; frrcfgd emits a bare 'vni <id>' block for it.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_AFI_SAFI_LOWERCASE_.desc: The EVPN tables key on the uppercase L2VPN_EVPN spelling, matching upstream PR 28089 and the literal frrcfgd hardcodes for its route-target cache key; the lowercase form used by BGP_GLOBALS_AF is rejected here.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_RT_VALID.desc: VRF-level EVPN route target with route-target-type both.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_RT_TYPE_MISSING_INVALID.desc: A route target row without route-target-type is rejected; frrcfgd dereferences the field unconditionally.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_RT_16BIT_OVERFLOW_INVAL.desc: A route target whose 2-octet component exceeds 65535 is rejected. rd-rt-format carried a [1-9][0-9]{1,4} alternative that subsumed the three range-checked branches above it, so the whole span 65536-99999 validated here and FRR then rejected it.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_RT_32BIT_OVERFLOW_INVAL.desc: A route target whose 4-octet component exceeds 4294967295 is rejected; the previous digit-class spelling accepted 4294967296.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_RT_BOUNDARY_VALID.desc: The maxima stay valid on both sides of rd-rt-format: 65535 for a 2-octet component and 4294967295 for a 4-octet one.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_RT_ZERO_VALID.desc: Zero is valid in the assigned-number position of every rd-rt-format union member. Each member carries its own |[0-9] alternative, so there is one row per form: a 2-octet ASN, an IPv4 address and a 4-octet ASN. Without these the alternation can lose |[0-9] again and the suite stays green, which is what happened between review rounds 2 and 3.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_RT_VALID.desc: Per-VNI EVPN route target attached to a VNI that exists in BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_RT_UNKNOWN_VNI_INVA.desc: A per-VNI route target for a VNI with no BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI row is rejected; the boot-time template nests the RT loop inside the VNI loop, so such a row would render nothing.

BGP_GLOBALS_EVPN_VNI_RT_CROSS_VRF_INVALI.desc: A per-VNI route target naming a VNI that exists only under a different VRF is rejected. The leafref predicate matches vrf_name and afi_safi, not just the VNI value, because the template matches the whole parent key and a cross-VRF row would render nothing.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_NO_ASN_NO_PEER_GROUP.desc: Configure an address-based BGP neighbor carrying neither an asn nor a peer group.
eStr: A BGP neighbor must carry an asn

BGP_NEIGHBOR_NEG_ASN_AND_PEER_TYPE.desc: asn and peer_type are alternate ways of supplying FRR's single remote-as value and are mutually exclusive; configuring both on the same neighbor must be rejected.
eStr: asn and peer_type are mutually exclusive

BGP_PEER_GROUP_NEG_ASN_AND_PEER_TYPE.desc: The must lives in the shared sonic-bgp-cmn grouping, so it applies to BGP_PEER_GROUP_LIST too; configuring both asn and peer_type on the same peer group must be rejected.
eStr: asn and peer_type are mutually exclusive

BGP_NEIGHBOR_PEER_TYPE_ONLY_FRR_VALID.desc: Under frrcfgd, a plain address-based BGP neighbor carrying only peer_type (no asn) is valid -- FRR supports 'neighbor <ip> remote-as external/internal' standalone, with the actual AS learned dynamically on session establishment.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_PEER_TYPE_ONLY_BGPCFGD_NEG.desc: Under bgpcfgd, a plain address-based BGP neighbor carrying only peer_type (no asn) is rejected; bgpcfgd renders remote-as from asn alone and has no rendering path for peer_type.
eStr: A BGP neighbor must carry an asn

BGP_NEIGHBOR_PEER_GROUP_ONLY_VALID.desc: With no DEVICE_METADATA to name the routing mode, an address-based BGP neighbor carrying a peer group and no asn stays valid, so subset validation still works.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_INTERFACE_NO_ASN_VALID.desc: With no DEVICE_METADATA to name the routing mode, an interface-attached BGP neighbor carrying no asn stays valid, so subset validation still works.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_INTF_NO_ASN_BGPCFGD_NEG.desc: Under bgpcfgd an interface-attached BGP neighbor carrying no asn is rejected; bgpcfgd renders its remote-as from asn alone.
eStr: A BGP neighbor must carry an asn

BGP_NEIGHBOR_INTF_NO_ASN_FRR_VALID.desc: Under frrcfgd an interface-attached BGP neighbor carrying no asn stays valid.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_PEER_GROUP_ONLY_BGPCFGD_NEG.desc: Under bgpcfgd a BGP neighbor carrying only a peer group is rejected; bgpcfgd never reads peer_group_name.
eStr: A BGP neighbor must carry an asn

BGP_NEIGHBOR_TEMPLATE_NEG_NO_ASN.desc: Configure a template-based BGP neighbor carrying no asn.
eStr: A template based BGP neighbor must carry an asn.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_RT_4BYTE_ASN_VALI.desc: A route-distinguisher and route targets using a 32-bit ASN. FRR accepts 4200000000:100 and keeps it; upstream PR 28089's patterns cannot express it, so rd-rt-format carries an extra union member for the RFC 4364 type 2 encoding.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_4BYTE_ASN_MAX_VAL.desc: The upper bound of the 32-bit ASN form, 4294967295:65535.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_RD_ASN_OVERFLOW_INVA.desc: An ASN above 2^32-1 is rejected; 4294967296 does not fit the 32-bit AS field.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_ADVERTISE_ROUTE_MAP_.desc: The EVPN type-5 advertisement with a route-map, for both IPv4 and IPv6.
A route-map without advertise-ipv4-unicast is rejected: FRR has no route-map without the advertisement.
eStr: advertise-ipv4-unicast-route-map requires advertise-ipv4-unicast to be true

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_ADVERTISE_ROUTE_MAP_.desc: The route-map leaf is rejected outside l2vpn_evpn.
eStr: advertise-ipv4-unicast-route-map is supported only for the l2vpn_evpn address family

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_EVPN_ADVERTISE_ROUTE_MAP_.desc: A route-map that is not in ROUTE_MAP_SET is rejected.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_VPN_LEAK_VALID.desc: Route-target VRF leaking on the unicast address families: rd/rt vpn, import/export vpn and the vpn route-maps, with rt_vpn_both on IPv6.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_VPN_LEAK_SINGLE_LEAF_VALI.desc: export_vpn alone is accepted. nhcli validates after each set line, so the sender's leaves must not require each other.

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_RD_VPN_EXPORT_ON_L2VPN_EV.desc: rd_vpn_export is rejected on l2vpn_evpn; FRR has the command only under the unicast address families.
eStr: rd_vpn_export is supported only for the ipv4_unicast and ipv6_unicast address families

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_RT_VPN_BOTH_WITH_IMPORT_I.desc: rt_vpn_both sets both of FRR's per-direction lists, so it cannot be combined with rt_vpn_import.
eStr: rt_vpn_both cannot be combined with rt_vpn_import or rt_vpn_export

BGP_GLOBALS_AF_IMPORT_VPN_WITH_IMPORT_VR.desc: FRR refuses import vpn while import vrf is configured on the same address family.
eStr: import_vpn cannot be combined with import_vrf or import_vrf_route_map

BGP_NEIGHBOR_VLAN_MISSING.desc: A BGP neighbor naming a VLAN that does not exist is refused.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_SUBINTF_VALID.desc: A BGP neighbor on an existing VLAN sub-interface is accepted.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_SUBINTF_MISSING.desc: A BGP neighbor naming a VLAN sub-interface that does not exist is refused.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_LOCAL_ADDR_VLAN_VALID.desc: A BGP neighbor local_addr naming an existing VLAN is accepted.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_LOCAL_ADDR_VLAN_MISSING.desc: A BGP neighbor local_addr naming a VLAN that does not exist is refused.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_VLAN_4095.desc: A BGP neighbor on Vlan4095 is refused.

BGP_NEIGHBOR_LOCAL_ADDR_VLAN_4095.desc: A BGP neighbor local_addr of Vlan4095 is refused.
